The activity status indicates whether or not a queue is currently inside of working hours. The list of queues and their activity can be used to determine which queues are currently able to receive incoming transfer requests. More info.

items.docs: Use this method to transfer a call to another queue. Please note that the targeted queue must be within working hours and have auto-assignment enabled for the transfer to succeed. The agent selection process will be run, and the conversation will be assigned to the agent who answers the call. More info.
